paite: Huan Solomon in a-inn kum sawm-le-thum alam a, huchi in a-inn pumpi alamzou vekta hi.
heading: Solomon Kumpi Inn

paite: Lebanon gammang inn, khuamvual li, khuam tung a sidar singpek tung ah alam a; adunglam tong zakhat ahi. Availam tong sawmnga ahi a, asanlam tong sawmthum ahi.
Huai khuam a kinga dantan sawmli-le-nga tunglam ah sidar singphel a khuh ahi a; vual khat ah sawm-le-nga zel ahi.
Vual thum ah tohlette a-om a, vak leh vakte bel vual thum in akigalsai vek uhi.
Kongkhak leh khuam tengteng singpek aning li nei a bawl ahi a, vak leh vakte vual thum in akigalsai vek uhi.
Inn lim khuam nei abawl a; adunglam tong sawmnga ahi a, availam tong sawmthum ahi. Huaite ma ah akhuamte leh ama a lutna tung kah toh inlim abawl hi.
Avaihawmna ding laltutphah inlim, vaihawmna inlim, avaihawmna ding abawl hi. Huai pialkhang langkhat a pan langkhat pha a sidar sing a khuh ahi.
Ama tenna ding in, inn lim nung a, huangsung intual dang nei om pen huchi mah bang a bawl ahi. Huai inlim mah bang in Solomon in zi a Pharaoh tanu aneih, inn ding leng alamsak lai hi.

Hiai tengteng suang manpha pipi, ahun geihgeih a sek zel suang, atna a at a lam ahi. Sunglam leng, polam leng asuangphum a pan alek pha in, huchi mah bang in polam ah huangsung intual lianpi tanpha in.
Suangphum suang manpha pipi, suang lian pipi, suang tong sawm leh suang tong giatte a lep ahi.
Huai tunglam ah suang manpha pipi, suang ahun geihgeih zel a sek leh sidar sing ahi.
Akimvel in huangsung intual lianpi suangsek chial thum leh sidar singpek thuah khat a um ahi. TOUPA' inn huangsung intual sunggilzaw leh inn inlim mah bang in.
Kumpipa Solomon in Tura a pan mi sawl in, Hiram asam hi.
heading: Hiram Nasep

paite: Huai mi Naphtali nam meithai tapa ahi a, apa Tura khomi, dalsekmi ahi. Amah dalsek lam himhim ah apil in atheisiam in akhutsiam petmah hi. Kumpipa Solomon kiang ah ahoh a, a-nna tengteng asepsak vek hi.
Dal khuam nih, tong sawm-le-giat a sang; akimvel a teh a tong sawm-le-nih a lian tuaktuak abawl hi.
heading: Dal Khuam Nihte / (2 Kro 3.15-17)

paite: Khuam lu a koih ding dal sunbawk nih abawl a; bawk khat sanlam tong nga ahi a, bawk khat pen sanlam tong nga mah ahi.
Khuampite dawn ah lubawkte gial im-iam leh kihek nginngian a-om a; hiai lubawk kisuangsawn bel khainiang kiphan sagih, bawk khat pen a ding in leng sagih mah a kituam ahi.
Huchi in khuamte abawl a; khuam lu a bawkte tuamna ding in gial im-iam khat tung ah akimvel vual nih a-om a; huchi mah bang in khat tung ah leng a-om lai hi.
Inn lim a khuam dawn a bawk ah lili lim atuang a, huai tong li ahi.
Khuam nih dawn a bawkte gei ah gial im-iam kiang ah theibuhfaite a-om a; theibuhfaite bel huai bawkte ah zanih tuaktuak a volh in a-om uhi.
Tempul inlim ah khuamte adingsak a; taklam khuam adingsak a, amin Jakin asa a; veilam khuam leng adingsak a; amin Boaz asa hi,
Khuamte dawn ah lili lim atuang a; huchi in khuam lam nasep teng zohsiang ahita.
Dal tuibem lianpi, tong sawm, asanlam tong nga asung a; agei tong sawmthum kimvel ahi.
heading: Dal Tuibem / (2 Kro 4.2-5)

paite: Agei nuai ah pakmum lim in akimvel vek a, tong sawm ahi a, tuibem kimvel in a-om hi. Huai pakmumte vual nih in a-om ua, sunkhawm pah ahi.
Huai bawngtal sawm-le-nih tung ah akinga a, thum in mallam anga ua, thum in tumlam anga ua, thum in simlam anga ua, thum in suahlam anga uhi. Atung uah tuibem akitung a, ameilam un asunglam adoh hi.
Khutpek chia a sah ahi a; agei lili pak bang, nou gei bang a bawl ahi. Bath sangnih takna ahi.
Dal in tunsawnna sawm abawl a; tunsawnna khat sau lam tong li ahi a, availam tong li mah ahi a, asanlam tong thum ahi.
heading: Dal Tunsawnnate

paite: Tunsawnna bawldan hichibang ahi. Huai in kuak anei a, huai kuakte ageite kikal ah a-om hi.
Ageite kikal a kuakte ah humpinelkaite, bawngtalte leh cherubte atuang ua; agei tungte ah tunsawnna a-om hi. Humpinelkaite leh bawngtalte nuailam ah kilawmsaknate a-om dindian hi.
Tunsawnnate ah dal kangtalai li leh dal tung chih a-om chiat a; aning lite ah kingakna a-om chiat hi. Kisilna nuailam ah akingakna sun a-om a, asik chiat ah kilawmsakna a-om chiat hi.
Valh gong sung tong khat ahi; akam kimvel valh bang a bem ahi a, tong khat-le-akim ahi. Akam gei kimvel gial kilawm ahi a, akuakte ning li ahi a, abem kei uh.
Akuak nuailam ah kangtalai lite a-om ua; kangtalai tungchihte tunsawnna ah a-om uhi. Kangtalai sandan tong khat-le-akim ahi,
Huai kangtalaite bawldan sakol kangtalai khe bawldan bang ahi a; atungchihte, avalhte, asutkalhnate leh laibawkte avek a sun ahi.
Tunsawnna ning li chiat ah kingakna li a-om a; huai kingaknate tunsawnna toh pum khat vek ahi uh.
Tunsawnna tung ah valh, tong kimkhat a sang a-om a; tunsawnna tung a atunna khete leh akuakte pum khat vek ahi.
Atunna khepekte leh akuakte ah azat bangbang in cherubte, humpinelkaite leh tum singte atuangsak a, akimvel in kilawmsakna a-om dindian hi.
Huchibang vek in tunsawnna sawm abawl a; avek in pum khat a sun ahi chiat ua, kikim chiat, bawldan kibang geih ahi chiat uh.
Kisilna bel sawm dal in abawl a; kisilna bel khat in bath sawmli adong a; kisilna bel tong li chiat ahi uh. Tunsawnna sawm tung ah kisilna bel khat akitung chiat hi.
Tunsawnnate inn taklam pang ah nga atung a, inn veilam pang ah nga mah. Tuibem pen inn taklam pang ah suahlam ah simlam nga in atung hi.
Hiram in kisilna belte, vutluahte, maiphiat kuangte abawl a, huchi in TOUPA inn a dia Solomon abawlsak teng azousiangta hi.
heading: Tempul Vante Genna Tomkim / (2 Kro 4.11—5.1)

paite: Khuam nihte, khuam dawn a bel bang a bawk nihte, khuam dawn a bel ban a bawk nih tuamna gial im-iam nihte,
tuamna gial im-iam nih a dia theibuhfai zalite, khuam dawn a bel bang a bawk nih tuamna ding gial im-iam tuaktuak a dia theibuhfai vual nihte;
tunsawnna sawm leh tunsawnna tung a kisilna bel sawmte;
tuibem khat leh tuibem nuai a bawngtal sawm-le-nihte,
belte, vutluahte leh maiphiat kuangte toh. Tui-um belsuan tengteng TOUPA' inn a dia Hiram in kumpipa Solomon abawlsak dal nawttet a bawl vek ahi.
Jordan Phaizang ah Sukkoth leh Zarethan kikal a bellei omna ah hiai teng kumpipa'n asung hi.
Huai tui-um belsuan tengteng atam mahmah ziak in Solomon in buk khe lou in akoih a; dal bukzah pen theihkhiak ahi kei hi.
Solomon in TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan om tengteng abawl a; dangka-eng maitam leh tanghou koihna dohkan dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Mun siangthoupen ma a khawnvak koihnate, taklam a nga leh veilam a ngate dangka-eng siang in; pakte, khawnvakte leh taitehte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Noute, khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, keute leh mei laknate dangka-eng siang in; insung gilzaw, Mun Siangthoupen kongkhakte leh inn, tempul, kongkhak bulhnate dangka-eng in aluan hi.

Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in TOUPA' inn a dia abawl tengteng azouvekta hi. Huchi in Solomon in apa David in ana latkhitsa dangka chite, dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuante alalut a, TOUPA' inn a goute lak ah akoihta hi.
